question: Should this inactive typo-only documentation branch be closed, or should the contributor be invited to replace it with a substantive README correction?
rationale: The only mechanical repair removes the entire proposed change, so this is a small contributor-workflow decision rather than a useful automated repair.

options.title: Close the branch
options.body: Close the PR because its only change is a typo and trailing whitespace with no mergeable improvement.

options.title: Request a replacement
options.body: Ask the contributor to submit a narrow, correct README improvement if they intended a different documentation change.

recommendation.title: Close the branch
recommendation.body: Close the PR because its only change is a typo and trailing whitespace with no mergeable improvement.
